author: Ari Koslow
title: John Brebbia expected to be called up by Rockies
desc: John Brebbia has a locker in the Rockies clubhouse on Sunday.
impact: Brebbia had signed a minor league deal with Colorado. There should be an official roster move announced later in the day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Corniell recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Rangers recalled RHP Jose Corniell from Triple-A Round Rock.
impact: Corniell has struggled in the Triple-A level this season. He could factor into the Rangers starting rotation with Jack Leiter headed to the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jack Leiter (ankle) placed on IL
desc: The Rangers placed RHP Jack Leiter on the 15-day injured list with a right ankle impingement.
impact: Leiter has been hit hard in his recent outings. He does not hold a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yilber Diaz designated for assignment
desc: The Diamondbacks designated RHP Yilber Díaz for assignment.
impact: Diaz loses his spot on the Diamondbacks 40-man roster with Arizona selecting the contract of Jose Cabrera. He could garner some interest on waivers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Philip Abner optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Diamondbacks optioned LHP Philip Abner to Triple-A Reno.
impact: Abner worked 2 2/3 innings in Saturday's loss against the Twins. He'll likely continue to move up and down throughout the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kohl Drake recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Diamondbacks recalled LHP Kohl Drake from Triple-A Reno.
impact: Drake has struggled in Triple-A this season to the tune of a 7.83 ERA. He figures to work in long relief out of the Diamondbacks bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Cabrera has contract selected by Diamondbacks
desc: The Diamondbacks selected the contract of RHP Jose Cabrera from Triple-A Reno.
impact: Cabrera is set to officially make his MLB debut on Sunday against the Twins. He'll be a wait-and-see player for fantasy managers early on.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ronel Blanco (elbow) to make rehab start Thursday
desc: Ronel Blanco will make a rehab start Thursday at Double-A Corpus Christi.
impact: Blanco is in the final stages of working his way back from Tommy John surgery. He'll require a lengthy rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lance McCullers Jr. (shoulder) to make rehab start Thursday
desc: Lance McCullers Jr. will make a rehab start Thursday at Triple-A in Sugar Land.
impact: McCullers figures to require a lengthy rehab assignment. He should be activated at some point in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jacob Young (side) out of lineup Sunday
desc: Jacob Young remains out of the Nationals lineup on Sunday against the Rays.
impact: Young left Saturday's game early after crashing into the outfield wall. He remains day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Williamson (shoulder) throws bullpen Saturday
desc: Brandon Williamson threw his first bullpen on Saturday.
impact: Williamson has been on the injured list with left shoulder fatigue since the end of April. He'll look to get cleared to face live hitters next.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ke'Bryan Hayes (back) able to swing
desc: Reds manager Terry Francona said Ke'Bryan Hayes has been able to swing.
impact: Francona spoke about Hayes working on adjustment that the hitting coaches want him to do. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Blue Jays/Cubs postponed Sunday
desc: Sunday's contest between the Toronto Blue Jays and Chicago Cubs has been postponed due to inclement weather according to Taylor McGregor.
impact: The originally scheduled contest has been rescheduled for Monday August 6.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Liam Hicks dealing with stiff back
desc: Marlins manager Clayton McCullough said Liam Hicks is dealing with stiffness in his back.
impact: Hicks will continue to receive treatment. There should be more clarity on his status later in the day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bobby Witt Jr. (knee) 'feeling better'
desc: Royals manager Matt Quatraro said Bobby Witt Jr. is feeling better and walking around better on Sunday.
impact: Witt remains out of the lineup on Sunday. He'll continue to receive treatment throughout the day.
